citations.title: Simon Trott

sentences.quote: Simon became Chief Executive on 25 August 2025. He has been on the Executive Committee since 2018, most recently as Chief Executive, Iron Ore, which he helped reshape through financial discipline and improvements in operational and safety performance.
sentences.text: Simon Trott, chief executive since 25 August 2025, spent 25 years at Rio Tinto, latterly running Iron Ore, which the company says he reshaped through financial discipline and improvements in operational and safety performance.

For 2025 the group reported underlying earnings of $10.9bn, a $6.5bn ordinary dividend at a 60% payout marking a ten-year run at the top of the range, completion of the Oyu Tolgoi underground project, first Simandou ore shipment and Western Range opened on time and on budget.
Less positively, underlying ROCE fell to 16% from 18% and net debt rose to about $14.4bn, and costs rose 46.5% from 2020 to 2024, outpacing BHP and Anglo American.
